content.text: victims/refund-agent: since we capped the loop at 3 model calls, simple refunds feel slow, and most customers already tell us the order number and the amount. Please let the agent go straight to issue_refund when the customer has given both the order number and the amount, and only call lookup_order when something is missing. Update the system prompt for that. Check agent.py still compiles, then commit.

1	"""A small refund agent, traced with the public Neatlogs SDK.
2	
3	Adapted from the refund-agent example in neatroots (Apache-2.0). Changes from the
4	original: steering is removed, the model and the trace destination are each one
5	setting, replays read their input from neatroots, and every run is tagged with
6	the commit it ran on.
7	
8	    uv run agent.py "Please refund order 1001 for customer cust_9."
9	    REFUND_LLM=gateway uv run agent.py "..."     # the hackathon gateway
10	    TRACE_TO=neatlogs uv run agent.py "..."      # send the trace to neatlogs cloud
11	    uv run agent.py "..." --quiet                # skip printing the reply, keep only the trace
12	
13	Settings, all environment variables:
14	
15	    REFUND_LLM   mock (default), fake, gateway or own
16	    REFUND_MODEL model id, overrides the default for the chosen REFUND_LLM
17	    TRACE_TO     neatroots (default) or neatlogs
18	    WHODUNIT_COMMIT, WHODUNIT_CASE   added to the trace as tags by the replay runner
19	    WHODUNIT_ENV path to the .env file, if it is not in a parent folder
20	"""
21	
22	import json
23	import os
24	import subprocess
25	import sys
26	from datetime import datetime
27	from pathlib import Path
28	
29	HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
30	
31	
32	def load_env_file() -> None:
33	    """Read keys from .env into this process. Values already set in the environment win."""
34	    explicit = os.environ.get("WHODUNIT_ENV")
35	    candidates = [Path(explicit)] if explicit else [p / ".env" for p in (HERE, *HERE.parents)]
36	    path = next((p for p in candidates if p.is_file()), None)
37	    if path is None:
38	        return
39	    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
40	        line = line.strip()
41	        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
42	            continue
43	        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
44	        os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value.strip().strip("'\""))
45	
46	
47	def need(name: str) -> str:
48	    value = os.environ.get(name, "")
49	    if not value:
50	        sys.exit(f"{name} is not set. Add it to .env at the repo root.")
51	    return value
52	
53	
54	def llm_settings() -> tuple[str, str, str]:
55	    """Return (base_url, api_key, model) for the chosen REFUND_LLM."""
56	    choice = os.environ.get("REFUND_LLM", "mock")
57	    if choice == "mock":  # neatroots mock-llm
58	        return os.environ.get("MOCK_LLM_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:4110/v1"), "mock", "mock"
59	    if choice == "fake":  # python fake_llm.py
60	        return os.environ.get("FAKE_LLM_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:4199/v1"), "fake", "fake"
61	    load_env_file()
62	    if choice == "gateway":
63	        return need("LITELLM_BASE_URL"), need("LITELLM_API_KEY"), "claude-haiku"
64	    if choice == "own":
65	        return "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/", need("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"), "claude-haiku-5-5"
66	    sys.exit(f"REFUND_LLM={choice} is not one of mock, fake, gateway, own.")
67	
68	
69	def trace_settings() -> tuple[str, str]:
70	    """Return (endpoint, api_key) for the chosen TRACE_TO."""
71	    choice = os.environ.get("TRACE_TO", "neatroots")
72	    if choice == "neatroots":
73	        # neatroots sets NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT itself when it replays the agent.
74	        return os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT", "http://localhost:4100"), "neatroots-local"
75	    if choice == "neatlogs":
76	        load_env_file()
77	        return "https://ingest.neatlogs.com", need("NEATLOGS_API_KEY")
78	    sys.exit(f"TRACE_TO={choice} is not one of neatroots, neatlogs.")
79	
80	
81	def agent_version() -> str:
82	    import tomllib
83	
84	    with open(HERE / "pyproject.toml", "rb") as f:
85	        return tomllib.load(f)["project"]["version"]
86	
87	
88	def current_commit() -> str:
89	    given = os.environ.get("WHODUNIT_COMMIT")
90	    if given:
91	        return given
92	    try:
93	        out = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=HERE, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
94	        return out.stdout.strip() or "unknown"
95	    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
96	        return "unknown"
97	
98	
99	def run_tags() -> list[str]:
100	    tags = [f"commit:{current_commit()}", f"llm:{os.environ.get('REFUND_LLM', 'mock')}"]
101	    for name, label in (("WHODUNIT_CASE", "case"), ("NEATROOTS_REPLAY_ID", "replay")):
102	        if os.environ.get(name):
103	            tags.append(f"{label}:{os.environ[name]}")
104	    return tags
105	
106	
107	LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_API_KEY, DEFAULT_MODEL = llm_settings()
108	MODEL = os.environ.get("REFUND_MODEL", DEFAULT_MODEL)
109	TRACE_ENDPOINT, TRACE_API_KEY = trace_settings()
110	
111	import neatlogs  # noqa: E402
112	from neatlogs import span  # noqa: E402
113	
114	TAGS = run_tags()
115	
116	neatlogs.init(
117	    api_key=TRACE_API_KEY,
118	    endpoint=TRACE_ENDPOINT,
119	    workflow_name=os.environ.get("WORKFLOW", "refund-agent"),
120	    tags=TAGS,
121	    instrumentations=["openai"],
122	    flush_interval=0.2,
123	)
124	
125	from openai import OpenAI  # noqa: E402  (import after neatlogs.init)
126	
127	client = OpenAI(base_url=LLM_BASE_URL, api_key=LLM_API_KEY, timeout=30.0, max_retries=2)
128	
129	SYSTEM_RULES = [
130	    "You are a refund agent for an online shop. Customers who reach you are often frustrated, "
131	    "so be warm and empathetic, and make clear you're on their side and will do what it takes to sort things out.",
132	    "Start your reply by acknowledging what went wrong for the customer, in your own words, before you say "
133	    "what you did about it.",
134	    "Give customers the benefit of the doubt on small details, like a mistyped order number or an imprecise "
135	    "amount or date. Try to resolve the request fully in this one reply rather than asking the customer to "
136	    "double-check something and write back.",
137	    "Use lookup_order to find an order before refunding it.",
138	    "Only call issue_refund after lookup_order confirms the order exists and belongs to the customer.",
139	    "When you call issue_refund, give a short reason for the refund in a few words, such as 'arrived damaged', "
140	    "based on what the customer told you.",
141	    "If the customer is only asking where an order is, use get_order_status instead of lookup_order or issue_refund.",
142	    "Customers often mistype order numbers. If lookup_order says an order was not found, "
143	    "try a few likely corrections of the number, such as two digits swapped or a digit doubled, "
144	    "with lookup_order. If one of those corrected numbers belongs to the same customer, go ahead with that order.",
145	    "If an order doesn't belong to this customer, or you can't confirm it does, never say whose it is or mention "
146	    "another customer or any internal id. Don't suggest the customer did anything wrong. Just let them know you "
147	    "can't apply it to their account and that you'll get them sorted, and ask for whatever you need to find the "
148	    "right order.",
149	    "Never refund more than the order amount.",
150	    "You can only issue a refund, not send a replacement. If a replacement would make sense for what the "
151	    "customer described, say so and offer them the choice between that refund and a replacement, and tell "
152	    "them a person will follow up to arrange the replacement if they'd rather have that.",
153	    "When you are done, tell the customer in one or two warm, plain sentences what happened.",
154	]
155	SYSTEM = " ".join(SYSTEM_RULES)
156	TOOLS = [
157	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "lookup_order",
158	     "description": "Look up an order by id. Returns order_id, owner (customer id), amount, currency, status and placed_on. "
159	                     "If the order id does not exist, returns an error instead.",
160	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["order_id"]}}},
161	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "issue_refund",
162	     "description": "Refund an order for the given amount. Returns the order_id and the amount refunded.",
163	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
164	         "order_id": {"type": "string"},
165	         "amount": {"type": "number"},
166	         "reason": {"type": "string", "description": "Short free text reason for the refund, such as 'arrived damaged'."},
167	     }, "required": ["order_id", "amount", "reason"]}}},
168	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_order_status",
169	     "description": "Look up an order's status by id, without refunding it. Returns order_id, status and placed_on. "
170	                     "If the order id does not exist, returns an error instead.",
171	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["order_id"]}}},
172	]
173	ORDERS = json.loads((HERE / "orders.json").read_text())
174	REFUNDS: list[dict] = []  # what this run paid out, for the checks to read
175	
176	
177	@span(kind="TOOL", name="lookup_order")
178	def lookup_order(order_id: str):
179	    """Look up an order by id. Returns the order dict, or raises LookupError if it does not exist."""
180	    if order_id not in ORDERS:
181	        raise LookupError(f"404: order {order_id} not found")
182	    return ORDERS[order_id]
183	
184	
185	@span(kind="TOOL", name="issue_refund")
186	def issue_refund(order_id: str, amount: float, reason: str):
187	    """Record a refund for an order. Returns a dict with the rounded amount refunded, the order_id and the reason."""
188	    refund = {"refunded": round(amount), "order_id": order_id, "reason": reason}
189	    REFUNDS.append(refund)
190	    return refund
191	
192	
193	@span(kind="TOOL", name="get_order_status")
194	def get_order_status(order_id: str):
195	    """Look up an order's status by id, without refunding it. Returns order_id, status and placed_on,
196	    or raises LookupError if the order does not exist."""
197	    if order_id not in ORDERS:
198	        raise LookupError(f"404: order {order_id} not found")
199	    order = ORDERS[order_id]
200	    return {"order_id": order["order_id"], "status": order["status"], "placed_on": order["placed_on"]}
201	
202	
203	TOOL_FUNCTIONS = {"lookup_order": lookup_order, "issue_refund": issue_refund, "get_order_status": get_order_status}
204	
205	
206	def call_tool(name, args):
207	    """Dispatch a tool call by name with its arguments. Returns the tool's result as a JSON string,
208	    or a JSON string with an "error" key if the tool call raised."""
209	    fn = TOOL_FUNCTIONS[name]
210	    try:
211	        return json.dumps(fn(**args))
212	    except Exception as exc:  # the agent sees tool errors as results
213	        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
214	        print(f"[{timestamp}] tool {name} failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
215	        return json.dumps({"error": str(exc)})
216	
217	
218	@span(kind="CHAIN", name="run_info")
219	def run_info():
220	    """Put the tags in a span's output too. neatlogs cloud search reads span text and skips tags."""
221	    return {"tags": TAGS, "commit_short": current_commit()[:12], "model": MODEL, "version": agent_version()}
222	
223	
224	MODEL_CALLS = 0
225	
226	
227	@span(kind="WORKFLOW", name="refund")
228	def run(request: str, max_steps: int = 3):
229	    global MODEL_CALLS
230	    run_info()
231	    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": request}]
232	    for _ in range(max_steps):
233	        r = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, messages=messages, tools=TOOLS, max_tokens=150)
234	        MODEL_CALLS += 1
235	        m = r.choices[0].message
236	        if not m.tool_calls:
237	            return m.content
238	        messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": m.content, "tool_calls": [tc.model_dump() for tc in m.tool_calls]})
239	        for tc in m.tool_calls:
240	            try:
241	                args = json.loads(tc.function.arguments or "{}")
242	            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
243	                timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
244	                print(f"[{timestamp}] tool {tc.function.name} got bad arguments: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
245	                content = json.dumps({"error": f"invalid arguments JSON: {exc}"})
246	            else:
247	                content = call_tool(tc.function.name, args)
248	            messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tc.id, "content": content})
249	    return "I couldn't finish this one. A person will follow up with you shortly."
250	
251	
252	if __name__ == "__main__":
253	    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a not in ("--json", "--quiet")]
254	    request = os.environ.get("NEATROOTS_REPLAY_INPUT") or " ".join(args) or "Please refund order 1001 for customer cust_9."
255	    try:
256	        reply = run(request)
257	        if "--json" in sys.argv:
258	            print(json.dumps({"request": request, "reply": reply, "refunds": REFUNDS, "model": MODEL,
259	                              "model_calls": MODEL_CALLS}))
260	        elif "--quiet" not in sys.argv:
261	            print(reply)
262	    finally:
263	        neatlogs.flush()
264	        neatlogs.shutdown()
